topic: Threshold, state target, duration, and wider coverage for February labor and civic actions
description: S001 establishes one STPE sit-in in N’Djamena on 21 Feb with wage arrears and management/revenue demands, but reports no simultaneous crowd size; the state-policy target and exact end date remain unresolved. Searches surfaced other strike announcements (teachers, public-service workers, territorial administration) but no independently established public gathering meeting ≥50. Feb regional/sector coverage may remain incomplete.
follow_up: Seek permitted independent local reporting on STPE attendance/continuity and actual public gatherings in N’Djamena and provinces across labor, student, professional, civic, women/youth sectors; do not infer gathering or threshold from membership, strike participation or announcement.
